# Document Control
SOP-LAB-001 Rev 2
Page 1 of 2
Effective Date: 2026-01-01

# Purpose
This SOP describes electronic record controls for the laboratory.

# Electronic records
1. The laboratory uses a closed electronic record system.
2. Electronic signatures are linked to their records.

# Training
3. Personnel complete training before using the system.
